tasks.title: Wire plan into Commander and remove from fallback
tasks.description:
Update `src/index.ts` to register `plan` as a native Commander command:

1. Remove `'plan'` from `SHELL_FALLBACK_COMMANDS` array
2. Add a `program.command('plan').description('...').action(async () => { ... })` that calls the main `runPlan` function from `src/commands/plan.ts`
3. In `src/commands/fallback.ts`, remove `plan: 'ralph_plan.sh'` from `COMMAND_SCRIPT_MAP`
4. Verify `RALPH_FORCE_SHELL=1` still delegates everything to shell (this is handled by existing logic in index.ts — just confirm it still works)
5. Update `test/index.test.ts` and `test/commands/fallback.test.ts` to reflect the changes

The `runPlan` function should orchestrate the full flow: preflight → planning session → notes review loop → task generation → task review loop, with the loops allowing back-navigation between phases.
tasks.notes: Added runPlan() to src/commands/plan.ts orchestrating: displayPreflight → launchPlanningSession → reviewNotesLoop → launchTaskGeneration → reviewTasksLoop with plan-signal back-navigation. Injectable deps (launchPlanningFn, launchTaskGenFn, shellFallbackFn, getGitStatusFn, editFn, runMenuFn) for testability. Removed 'plan' from SHELL_FALLBACK_COMMANDS in index.ts and added native plan Commander command. Removed plan from COMMAND_SCRIPT_MAP in fallback.ts (now falls back to bin/ralph plan). Updated all affected tests. Added 6 runPlan tests (385 passing). One pre-existing flaky test in launchTaskGeneration (TTS socket ENOENT) fails only in full suite due to Bun module cache bleed; passes when run in isolation.

tasks.title: Verify bun build --compile produces working binary
tasks.description:
Run `bun build --compile` (check package.json for the exact build script) and verify the compiled binary works:

1. Run the build command
2. Test `./ralph-bin plan --help` (or whatever the binary name is) doesn't crash
3. Test `./ralph-bin status` still works (regression check on previously ported commands)
4. Test `./ralph-bin logs` still works
5. If the build embeds `src/tasks-schema.json`, verify it's included (the prompt builder reads it via `fs.readFileSync` relative to `import.meta.dir` — this may need adjustment for compiled binaries)

If `import.meta.dir` doesn't resolve correctly in the compiled binary for reading `tasks-schema.json`, the schema content may need to be inlined as a string constant at build time or imported directly. Fix any issues found.

tasks.title: Fix healthCheck in ralph.json
tasks.description: The ralph.json healthCheck is set to `bun build` which fails because it has no entrypoint. Change it to `bun run build` so it uses the build script from package.json (`bun build --compile src/index.ts --outfile dist/ralph`).
